project_type: Vite-bundled Three.js immersive web experience with GSAP animations
build_system: Vite 8 with multi-page rollup input (index.html + species/*.html)
test_framework: No test framework. Validation is via vite build success.
test_command: npm run build (no unit tests exist)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to confirm no compilation/bundling errors. 2. Check that dist/ is produced with all entry points.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is the build output deployed to GitHub Pages. Not checked into git.
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available. Use npm run build for validation. External texture URLs (unpkg three-globe) used at runtime, not needed for build. No test suite exists.
contribution_requirements: Branch from feat/consolidated-v1 (done - now on feat/globe-immersion). Deploy via GitHub Pages from main. No linting or testing gates beyond build success.
key_patterns: - Three.js scene managed by CinematicEngine class (src/cinematic-engine.js) with EffectComposer for post-processing. Globe class (src/globe.js) handles Earth sphere, hotspot columns, raycasting, and layer system. GSAP ScrollTrigger drives camera keyframes via scroll progress 0-1. Overlay sections rendered as fixed HTML divs shown/hidden by OverlayUI based on progress. Species pages are separate HTML files loading species-page.js which fetches JSON from public/data/. Barba.js for SPA transitions. Lenis for smooth scrolling. Species data in public/data/*.json with rich fields (taxonomy, habitat, threats, conservation, cultural_depth, tmdb_media, globe_layers, photos, com_b, interesting_facts). 31 HOTSPOTS defined in globe.js with lat/lng for 10 species.
directory_structure: Root: index.html (main entry), vite.config.js, package.json. src/: main.js (init), cinematic-engine.js (Three.js scene), globe.js (Earth + data viz), overlay-ui.js (scroll-driven HTML overlays), transitions.js (card zoom), hover-3d.js (3D tilt), style.css, species-page.js (species detail renderer), species-page.css. public/data/: 10 species JSON files. species/: 10 HTML entry points for species detail pages.
